<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/work.ts -->
<!--
  Projects of a studio or a person: cards with tags and links, a compact grid, tiles with the caption over the
  picture, a bento with one big project, or a list beside a collage. Axes: layout (cards, compact, overlay,
  bento, list), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Project, ProjectLabels } from "./project-grid.types";

export type ProjectGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  projects: Project[];
  labels: ProjectLabels;
  layout?: "cards" | "compact" | "overlay" | "bento" | "list";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import ProjectTiles from "../components/project-tiles.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  projects,
  labels,
  layout = "cards",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<ProjectGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: ((layout as string) === 'list'), align: 'start' }"
  >
    <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'list')" gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="items">
      <Group
        v-for="p in projects"
        :key="p.id"
        gap="4"
        align="start"
        class="border-b border-border pb-4"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="p.title" ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0" />
        <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" class="flex-1">
          <Group gap="4" justify="between">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ p.title }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ p.year }}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ p.summary }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    </Stack>
    <ProjectTiles v-else :projects="projects" :labels="labels" :layout="layout" />
    <template #aside>
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4" data-testid="collage">
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" class="mt-8" />
      </Box>
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
